$description: Primitive layer / z-index stacking tokens. Defines standardized stacking planes across all views and platforms.

base.$description: Default base stacking plane for canvas surfaces and standard document flow

raised.$description: Elevated plane for sticky navigation bars, table headers, and elevated cards

dropdown.$description: Floating plane for dropdown menus, select listboxes, popovers, and tooltips

overlay.$description: Overlay plane for modal dialogs, full-screen backdrops, and side drawers

toast.$description: Top-level plane for global notification toasts, alerts, and critical system dialogs
